# Uses Missed by a Line Search

A reference that [wraps
across lines] still uses its definition.

Nested brackets: [[note]].

An escaped bracket: [a\]b].

A malformed inline link falls back to a reference: [fallback](not a url).

[wraps across lines]: https://example.com/wraps
[note]: https://example.com/note
[a\]b]: https://example.com/escaped
[fallback]: https://example.com/fallback
